avoidWhen.text: Avoid for single-item command failures; use error-recovery instead.

customize.text: Group failed items above succeeded items or offer a filter between failed and succeeded rows.

keep.text: Announces the batch outcome summary in a live status or alert region.
Exposes each failed item's recovery control in the accessibility tree without re-entering succeeded items.
Fits a narrow viewport without clipping failed-item reasons or recovery controls.
Keep each failed item's error reason visible and exposed to assistive technology alongside its item identity.

default.text: Mount a batch partial failure from spec/wire/batch-result.json showing 1 succeeded and 1 failed item with a live outcome summary and a retry or fix control for the failed item.

summary: Report per-item outcomes of a batch command so succeeded items stay done and failed items expose reasons and recovery controls.

useWhen.text: Use when a batch result reports both succeeded and failed items so the person can resolve only the failed items.
